description:
The buyer prompts Sightkick tracks in AI answers, and their answers.
view:
- list: Every tracked prompt with its visibility, sentiment, position, brands named and gap verdict.
- prompt(promptId): One prompt in depth: its sources and its runs per AI model (each runId opens an answer).
- answer(runId): One stored answer in full: its text, cited sources, brands found.
- suggestions(keyword?, limit?): Questions buyers ask that nobody tracks yet, from People Also Ask and the site's own searches. A keyword opens its Google results page for more, free (as check_web serp).
- rechecks: Questions booked to be asked again (ask_ai recheck): the answer then and, once asked again, now.
- models: Every AI model, which are tracked, and the plan's count.
name: get_prompts
title: Get tracked prompts
